svg.title: Git AI — Git safety
svg.desc: Feature overview for Git AI for JetBrains IDEs. Informational artwork, not an IDE screenshot. Commit messages are illustrative examples.
svg.text: Polishing uses the recorded commit. Newer staged work stays separate.
Applied only if ref is unchanged
Newer index and worktree changes are never used to build the replacement commit.
AI commit messages · IntelliJ IDEA & compatible JetBrains IDEs
